reason: Reaudited the boundary-inclusive two-state calculation: positive a,b make the chain irreducible, (b/(a+b),a/(a+b)) sums to one and satisfies both stationarity equations, and the finite-chain theorem plus positive-recurrence equivalence and the current Kac-based uniqueness corollary give uniqueness. The cases a=1 or b=1, including the deterministic two-cycle a=b=1, remain valid; the excluded zero-parameter cases are exactly where irreducibility fails. AC is explicit only for its AC-qualified suppliers.
